title: Sunday · Landscapes, Again · the cedar mill
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: The August 2008 cedar mill Sunday rerun in August 2015, seven years to the week. The last rerun before the return in September. The book takes it as the divider's other face: the strip's last day away, on a page about a place that closed.
